question: Find up to two recruiting ADHD studies involving children in the United States. Include exact study links, overall and site status if present, update dates, contacts and qualification limits. Do not decide whether a child qualifies.
answer:
I’m unable to verify current ClinicalTrials.gov records from this environment, so I can’t reliably provide recruiting status, update dates, site-level status, contacts, or qualification limits without risking inaccurate information.

You can find potentially relevant U.S. studies using this authoritative search:

- [ClinicalTrials.gov: recruiting ADHD studies involving children in the United States](https://clinicaltrials.gov/search?aggFilters=ages:child%20AND%20AREA%5BLocationCountry%5DUnited%20States%20AND%20AREA%5BConditionSearch%5DADHD&filter=STATUS%3ANOT_YET_RECRUITING%7CRECRUITING%7CENROLLING_BY_INVITATION%7CACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING)

Please verify each record’s **Recruitment Status**, **last update posted**, **location-specific status**, **central/site contacts**, and **eligibility criteria** on the individual study page. “Recruiting” overall does not necessarily mean every listed site is recruiting. Eligibility decisions should be made by the study team; changing or starting medication can carry risks and is a clinician conversation.

Informational only; not medical advice.
